verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents Honeymarker, its own lightweight CLI, but it only handles CRUD of markers. There is no evidence of a general-purpose official CLI for querying data or managing triggers, SLOs, boards or datasets, which the MCP server and REST API cover instead. Missing for 10: a general-purpose official CLI covering queries and resource management, AI-native or agent-oriented CLI workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Add, update, and delete Honeycomb markers from the command line using curl or Honeymarker, Honeycomb's lightweight marker management CLI.
a lightweight marker management tool that provides a CRUD command line interface
